title: Investigation Reports Unauthorized Deepfake Pornography Harms Thousands of Celebrities

behaviors.text: A Channel 4 News investigation alleges that nearly 4,000 celebrities globally, including 255 British [person], were victims of deepfake pornography.
Faces were superimposed onto explicit content using AI, with the top deepfake sites garnering 100 million views in three months, according to their findings.
